quarterly_data.signal: Correction (filed 08-24-2026) to the Pyeongtaek 345kV substation new-build contract for Samsung Electronics (Godeok general industrial complex, block A4-1; first disclosed 2024-10-11): the contract amount rises to KRW 193,152,300,000 incl.
